sentences.en: When I left the train station, I saw a man.
sentences.zh: 我离开火车站时，看到一个男人。

sentences.en: The express train does not stop between Shibuya and Naka-Meguro.
sentences.zh: 从涩谷到中目黑之间没有停靠站的特快列车。

sentences.en: The express train is an hour faster than the local.
sentences.zh: 特快列车比普通列车快一个小时。
